A LITTLE SOMETHING FOR YOU ✨

Memories, Wrapped as Gifts 🎁

Some gifts are not things you can hold…
they're little moments you can keep forever. 🦋

GIFT 01 · PRECIOUS MEMORY 💗

A Beautiful Moment 👀💗

In aankhon ka kya kehna,
ye khud ek kahaani hain…
Hum toh bas dekhne aaye the,
aur ye dil ki chor nikli. 👀💗🦋

Yre kuchh logon ko hona kitna pyara hota h na 🫠. Ab tum khudko hi dekh lo tumhara hona kitna haseen tha ... Jaise ki chand ho 🎀 prithvi ki koi suhani si shaam ho ya koi chai ki pyali si 💗 tumhari aankhein hai kitni pyari si 🎀.

Yr mai jab bhi akela hota hu na hamesha tumhari is pyari si tasveer ko dekhta rehta hu .. kitni pyari lagti ho tum hamesha tumhe dekh kr doob jaata hu .. Kaash kisi shaam mai tumhe ghuma pata .. Kaash .. kabhi kabhi bohot jyada hi yaad aati h tumhari aur meri ye aakhein ikdam se namm hojati h .. I'm wishing you a very happy birthday... May you enjoy your day ...

Aankhein aapki itni haseen hain,
ki nazar hatana mushkil ho gaya…
Bas ek jhalak kya dekhi,
dil ko aapse ishq sa ho gaya. 👀🥹💗

GIFT 02 · A FAVOURITE MEMORY 💙

The Gurl Who Stole My Dil 💙

Kuchh log bas tasveeron mein achhe nahi lagte,
woh tasveer se nikal kar dil mein utar jaate hain…
Aur tum… pata nahi kab,
meri favourite kahaani ban gayi. 🦋💗

Pata hai, tumhari is tasveer mein kuchh toh aisa hai jo har baar mujhe rok leta hai… 🫠 Kabhi tumhari smile dekhta hoon, kabhi bas chup-chaap tumhe dekhta rehta hoon. Tumhe shayad andaaza bhi nahi hai ki ek simple si tumhari tasveer kisi ke liye kitni special ho sakti hai. 💗

Kuchh log zindagi mein aate hain aur bas ek yaad ban kar reh jaate hain… aur kuchh log bina kuchh kahe bhi dil mein apni jagah bana lete hain. Tum unhi mein se ho. 🎀

Sach kahun toh… dil churane ki permission maangi bhi nahi thi tumne, phir bhi pata nahi kab mera dil tumhare naam ho gaya. 🫠💙

Dil chura kar poochhti ho,
batao mera kasoor kya hai? 👀
Ab tum hi batao mohtarma,
tumse pyaara bhi toh kuchh nahi hai. 💗🦋

GIFT 03 · THE CHAOTIC ONE 😂

Uff Ye Mahila… 😂🦋

Uff ye mahila… kya kehna inka,
kabhi sukoon, kabhi pareshani hain… 😂💗
Kabhi hasa deti hain bina wajah,
aur kabhi bas ek tasveer se yaad aa jaati hain. 🦋

Pata nahi aap mein aisa kya hai madam, ki aapko jitna samajhne ki koshish karo, utni hi interesting lagti ho. 😭😂 Kabhi lagta hai kitni seedhi-si cute si ladki ho… aur agle hi pal lagta hai, uff ye mahila toh alag hi level ki hai. 🫠💗

Aapki chhoti-chhoti baatein, aapka woh andaaz, aur woh random si cute harkatein… sab kuch yaad reh jaata hai. Shayad aapko khud bhi nahi pata hoga ki aapki presence kitni pyari memories chhod jaati hai. 🎀

Aur haan madam, aaj aapka birthday hai toh zyada attitude allowed hai. 😭😂 Bas itna yaad rakhna… aap jitni bhi “uff ye mahila” ho, special toh ho. 💗🦋

Uff ye mahila, kamaal karti hain,
bina kuch kahe bhi dil mein sawaal karti hain… 👀
Kabhi hansi, kabhi yaad, kabhi ek tasveer ban kar,
pata nahi kaise itni khaas ban jaati hain. 💗🦋

Bas teen chhote gifts…
aur unke andar tumhari teen pyaari si memories. 🦋💗

A Letter For You 💌

Dear Mohtarma, Pata nahi ye letter exactly kahan se shuru karun… aur sach bolun toh shayad mujhe khud bhi nahi pata. Itni saari baatein hain jo kehni hain, itni saari memories hain jo yaad aati hain, aur phir bhi jab likhne baithta hoon toh lagta hai ki words hi kam pad gaye. 🥹 Aaj tumhara birthday hai. 🎂💗 Aur pata nahi kyun, tumhare birthday par purani baatein aur bhi zyada yaad aa rahi hain. Jaise dimaag ne decide kar liya ho ki aaj woh saari chhoti-chhoti memories ek-ek karke saamne laayega… aur main bas baitha unhe yaad karta rahunga. 🦋 Kabhi-kabhi sochta hoon ki memories actually hoti kya hain? Shayad woh moments jo us waqt bilkul normal lagte hain, lekin waqt beetne ke baad achanak samajh aata hai ki “arre… ye toh kitna pyara tha.” 💗 Aur tumhare saath aisi memories ki kami toh bilkul nahi hai. 😭 Mujhe yaad hain tumhare woh pyare-pyare voice notes… 🥹🎀 Kabhi bas tumhari awaaz sunne ke liye unhe dobara sun lena… phir pata nahi kaise ek chhoti si smile aa jaati thi. Shayad tumhe kabhi andaaza bhi nahi hua hoga ki tumhari ek simple si voice note bhi kisi ke liye kitni special memory ban sakti hai. 🦋 Aur phir woh lambi-lambi VC wali raatein… 🌙💗 Video call shuru hoti thi aur pata hi nahi chalta tha ki waqt kab itna nikal gaya. Kabhi kuch khaas baat nahi hoti thi, kabhi random si baatein chalti rehti thi, kabhi bas ek-doosre ko dekhte hue time nikal jaata tha… lekin shayad wahi toh sabse khoobsurat part tha. Aaj tumhara birthday hai aur main un raaton ke baare mein soch raha hoon toh ek ajeeb si feeling hoti hai. 🥹 Kyunki tab shayad humne kabhi socha bhi nahi hoga ki ek din wahi ordinary si nights itni special memories ban jayengi. Aur haan… tumhari woh pyari si clingy harkatein. 😭💗 Uff. 😂 Us waqt kabhi-kabhi tumhari harkatein dekh kar sochta tha, “ye kya kar rahi hai madam?” 😭 Lekin aaj wahi cheezein yaad aati hain toh lagta hai ki kaash woh moments thode aur lambe hote. Shayad life ki sabse ajeeb baat hi ye hai na… Jab koi moment chal raha hota hai toh hum uski value poori tarah samajh nahi paate. Aur jab woh moment memory ban jaata hai, tab hum uski chhoti se chhoti detail ko bhi yaad karne lagte hain. 🦋 Aur phir kaise bhool sakta hoon Roblox ke andar wali shaadi? 😭😂💍 Matlab seriously… Roblox ke andar shaadi. 😂 Humari duniya bhi kya hi alag level ki thi. Log real life mein memories bana rahe the aur hum Roblox mein apni hi duniya basa ke baithe the. 😭💗 Lekin honestly, woh bhi kitna cute tha na? Aaj tumhare birthday par jab main peeche mudkar dekhta hoon toh lagta hai ki humne kitni random cheezon ko bhi special bana diya tha. 🎀 Kabhi voice notes, kabhi long VC, kabhi random baatein, kabhi woh clingy moments aur kabhi Roblox ki duniya… Kuch bhi extraordinary nahi tha, phir bhi sab kuch extraordinary lagta tha. 🥹🦋 Aur shayad isi wajah se tumhari memories mere liye sirf memories nahi hain. Woh meri life ke un pages ki tarah hain jinhe main kabhi-kabhi bina kisi reason ke khol leta hoon. 📖💗 Bas dekhne ke liye ki un pages par kya likha tha… aur phir thodi der ke liye wahi purani duniya yaad aa jaati hai. Aur tumhara birthday… 🎂 Pata nahi kyun, tumhare birthday par ye sab aur zyada yaad aata hai. Shayad kyunki aaj woh din hai jab tum duniya mein aayi thi. Aur main ye sochta hoon ki agar tum us din duniya mein aayi hi nahi hoti, toh meri life ki ye saari memories bhi kabhi hoti hi nahi. 🥹💗 Kitni ajeeb si baat hai na? Ek date calendar par aati hai, aur kisi aur insaan ke liye woh bas ek date hoti hai… lekin mere liye us date ke saath ek poori kahaani judi hui hai. 🦋 Aur us kahaani mein ek memory aisi bhi hai jo shayad main kabhi nahi bhool paunga… Woh raat jab main ro raha tha aur tum mujhe chup kara rahi thi. 🥹 Shayad tumhare liye woh bas ek moment raha ho. Shayad tumhe yaad bhi na ho ki exactly kya hua tha. Lekin mere liye kisi ka us waqt ruk kar mujhe sambhalna… meri baat sunna… aur mujhe chup karane ki koshish karna… woh chhoti baat nahi thi. 💗 Kabhi-kabhi kisi insaan ki importance kisi grand gesture mein nahi hoti. Bas itna hota hai ki jab tumhari duniya thodi heavy ho jaaye, tab koi tumhare paas ruk jaaye. 🦋 Aur tumne us raat wahi kiya tha. Isliye aaj, tumhare birthday par, main us memory ke liye bhi tumhe thank you kehna chahta hoon. 🥹💗 Thank you un saari chhoti-chhoti cheezon ke liye jo shayad tumne kabhi seriously sochi bhi nahi hongi. Thank you un voice notes ke liye. 🎀 Thank you un lambi VC nights ke liye. 🌙 Thank you un pagal si clingy harkaton ke liye. 😭😂 Thank you us Roblox wali shaadi ke liye. 💍😂 Aur thank you us raat ke liye jab tumne mujhe chup karaya tha. 🥹🦋 Happy Birthday, Mohtarma. 🎂💗 Aaj ke din meri bas ye wish hai ki tum genuinely khush raho. Tumhari life mein bahut saari achhi cheezein aayein, tumhare dreams poore hon, tumhe woh saari happiness mile jo tum deserve karti ho. 🌸✨ Jab bhi life difficult lage, I hope tumhe koi na koi reason milta rahe smile karne ka. 🥹💗 Jab bhi tumhe lage ki things aren’t going your way, I hope tumhe yaad rahe ki bad days permanent nahi hote. 🌙 Aur aaj birthday hai tumhara, toh ek request bhi hai… Thoda extra smile karna. 😭💗 Aaj tumhe officially allowed hai ki tum thoda zyada attitude dikhao. 😂🎀 Aakhir birthday girl ho. Aur haan… apni woh cute si harkatein bilkul mat badalna. 🦋 Thodi pagal, thodi clingy, thodi annoying… aur bilkul apni wali. 😭😂💗 Pata nahi future kitni cheezein badal dega. Log badlenge, situations badlenge, life apne alag-alag raste choose karegi… lekin kuch memories aisi hoti hain jo bas apni jagah bana leti hain. Tumhare saath wali woh memories bhi mere liye kuch aisi hi hain. 🦋 Main unhe kisi naam mein define nahi karna chahta. Bas itna kehna chahta hoon— Woh waqt pyara tha. Woh memories pyari thi. Aur un memories mein tum bahut pyari thi. 💗 Aaj tumhara birthday hai, aur agar ye poora letter padhte-padhte tumhare face par ek chhoti si smile bhi aa gayi ho… toh samajhna mera ye chhota sa birthday gift successful ho gaya. 🥹🎁🦋 So once again… Happy Birthday, Mohtarma. 🎂💗🦋 Khush rehna. Muskurate rehna. Aur haan… thodi si waise hi pagal rehna. 😭😂🎀 Some people become memories. Some memories become stories. And some stories… bas dil ke kisi kone mein quietly reh jaati hain. 🦋💗 — From someone who still remembers the little things. 🥹🦋 So I made this little place just for you. Every flower, every little animation, and every word here was made with one simple thought: I wanted to make you smile. Some memories may be small, but that doesn't make them any less special. And before you reach the end, there's just one more thing I want you to see... With lots of good wishes, from someone who made this little world for you. 💜

🦋
HAPPY BIRTHDAY

AROHI 💜

May your birthday be filled with smiles,
beautiful moments and memories worth keeping. 🎂🦋
